title: Für Elise · 五線譜工作室

easy.label: Easy
easy.sourceLabel: Für Elise · Mutopia 931 · A 小調
easy.description: 主旋律每個八分音格第一個音，加每小節首個低音；其餘由伴奏補齊。
easy.performanceForm: Complete supplied public-domain MIDI form; no extra repeat playback; pickup padded by one quarter rest.

normal.label: Normal
normal.sourceLabel: Für Elise · Mutopia 931 · A 小調
normal.description: 保留 Easy，再優先填補較稀疏小節，加入真實旋律及低音；其餘由伴奏補齊。
normal.performanceForm: Complete supplied public-domain MIDI form; no extra repeat playback; pickup padded by one quarter rest.

hard.label: Hard
hard.sourceLabel: Für Elise · Mutopia 931 · A 小調
hard.description: 保留 Normal，再按每小節密度補入原譜音；其餘由伴奏補齊。
hard.performanceForm: Complete supplied public-domain MIDI form; no extra repeat playback; pickup padded by one quarter rest.

extreme.label: Extreme
extreme.sourceLabel: Für Elise · Mutopia 931 · A 小調
extreme.description: Mutopia 931 完整 MIDI 演奏形態全部實體起音，無自動伴奏；並非只得開頭主題。
extreme.performanceForm: Complete supplied public-domain MIDI form; no extra repeat playback; pickup padded by one quarter rest.

mutopia931.title: Für Elise
mutopia931.repeatPolicy: Use complete supplied MIDI form exactly once, no invented repeats.
mutopia931.notationPolicy: Exact MIDI note-on and release; sharp/flat spellings regenerated in A minor. Grace performances differ from archival written notation; LilyPond source included for source engraving.

notice: 原始 MIDI 嘅 0.5 拍弱起前補 1 拍休止以成完整 3/8 小節；唔轉調，三連音及裝飾音時間保留。播放及重建唔需要互聯網。
